options: _________ he has a good job, he doesn't complain.
_________ they have very little money, they are happy.
_________ she was tired, she tried to study hard.
_________ she caught a bad cold, she had to take the exam.
_________ Jessica is rich, she spends little money.
questions.question: 다음 빈칸에 접속사 though가 들어가기에 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: though는 '~이지만, ~에도 불구하고'라는 역접의 의미를 가진다. 5번은 '제시카는 부자이지만 돈을 적게 쓴다'는 의미로 역접이 맞지만, 문제에서는 '어색한 것'을 찾고 있으므로 다시 검토 필요. 실제로 1-5 모두 though가 자연스럽게 사용되어 있다.

options: ____the traffic was bad, we arrived on time.
I went home early____ I wasn't feeling well.
____he is poor, he always helps other people.
We hardly ever see each other ____ we live on the same street.
Brian quickly did his homework ____ he couldn't concentrate well.
questions.question: 다음 빈칸에 접속사 although가 들어가기에 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: although는 역접의 의미를 가지므로, 4번의 '우리는 같은 거리에 살지만 거의 만나지 않는다'는 내용에서 although 대신 even though나 despite가 적절하다. 4번에서 although보다 다른 연결어가 필요하다.

options: ____they are poor, they're happy.
I will do my best ____ the problem is very difficult.
____it was cold, they played outside.
____she is young, she is very brave.
____I got up late, I was late for school.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 문맥상 '그들은 가난하지만 행복하다'는 역접의 의미가 필요하므로 although 또는 though가 적절하다.

options: ____it rained, they went jogging.
I couldn't sleep ____, I was tired.
____the traffic was heavy, I arrived late.
____he didn't study much, he passed the test.
It is pretty warm ____ it is a little windy.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 문맥상 '교통이 혼잡했지만 나는 제시간에 도착했다'는 역접의 의미가 필요하므로 although 또는 though가 적절하다.

options: We've played better ____ you joined our team.
____ the party, she hasn't spoken to him at all.
____ the Earth is rotating, two tides occur each day.
I felt hungry, ____ I made myself a sandwich.
I left school in 1995, and ____ then I've lived in London.
questions.question: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 다른 하나는?

options: He wore a short T-shirt ____ it was freezing.
I had a headache ____ I stayed up all night.
They put on sunglasses ____ it was really dark.
I'll buy a brand new car ____ it's so expensive.
She always passes her exams ____ she does not study at all.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 문맥상 인과관계를 나타내는 접속사 because 또는 so가 필요하다.

options: I can sleep ____ it's very noisy.
I don't like him ____ he isn't honest.
____ it was raining, I didn't get wet.
____she is pretty, she isn't content with her face.
I was late for school ____ I got up early in the morning.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 문맥상 '나는 잠을 잘 수 없다 (왜냐하면) 너무 시끄럽다'는 의미이므로 because가 필요하다.

options: ____ you're late, you can't watch the musical.
____ the food is not tasty, you'd better say nice things to the cook.
____ it is very cold, you'd better not go outside.
____ you don't feel well, we'll take care of your part.
____ I am not good at speech, why don't you make the presentation?
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 Since가 들어가기에 적절하지 않은 문장은?
questions.explanation: Since는 원인, 이유, 또는 시간적 의미를 가진다. 2번 문장은 Since로 시작하면 부자연스럽다.

options: ____ what she cooked wasn't tasty, I ate it all.
We played soccer ____ it was raining outside.
____ I wondered what made him nervous, I didn't ask him.
He didn't go to the meeting ____ he was sick.
The car was expensive ____ it was old and worn.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 문맥상 '나는 그가 왜 신경 쓰는지 궁금했지만 묻지 않았다'는 역접의 의미이므로 but/yet이 필요하다.

options: ____ summer is a fun season, I can't stand the heat!
____ tomatoes are low in calories, they make you feel full.
____ it explains everything very clearly, it is a really useful book.
____he was in poor health, he continued to carry out his duties.
____ the house was destroyed, no one was hurt.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 4번은 문법적으로 완전하지 않은 문장으로 다른 문장들과 구조가 다르다.

options: It rained too much to go to the music concert.
It rained a lot, but Jiwon went to the music concert.
After it rained a lot, Jiwon went to the music concert.
Jiwon was going to go to the music concert when it rained a lot.
Jiwon didn't go to the music concert because it rained a lot.
questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

Although jiwon couldn't concentrate well she quickly did her homework. [ Althouh it rained a lot, Jiwon still went to the music concert ] after doing her homework. Although there were too many people in the concert hall, the concert was wonderful.
questions.explanation: 지문: 'Although Jiwon couldn't concentrate well, she quickly did her homework. Although it rained a lot, Jiwon still went to the music concert after doing her homework. Although there were too many people in the concert hall, the concert was wonderful.' 이는 비가 많이 내렸지만 지원이 음악 콘서트에 간 것을 나타낸다.

options: After Sora was learning how to swim, her mom watched her.
While Sora was learning how to swim, her mom watched her.
As soon as Sora was learning how to swim, her mom watched her.
Before Sora was learning how to swim, her mom watched her.
During Sora was learning how to swim, her mom watched her.
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 합쳐서 한 문장으로 만들 때, 어느 것이 올바른가?

⊙ Sora was learning how to swim.
⊙ Sora's mom watched Sora at that time.
questions.explanation: 지문: 'Sora was learning how to swim. Sora's mom watched Sora at that time.' While은 동시에 일어나는 두 사건을 연결하는 데 적절하다.

options: If I get up early, I will be late for school.
If he is happy, I will be happy, too.
If we study hard, we will get bad grades.
If she is smart, she can fail the test.
If the weather is good, we can't go on a picnic.
questions.question: 다음 중 의미가 가장 자연스러운 문장은?
questions.explanation: 조건문에서 조건과 결과가 논리적으로 일치하는 문장은 2번이다.

options: If we take a taxi, we will not be late.
If it is sunny, we will go on a picnic.
If you hurry, you can catch the last bus.
If you practice hard, you can't win the contest.
If the box is not too heavy, I will carry it for you.
questions.question: 다음 중 의미가 가장 자연스럽지 않은 문장은?
questions.explanation: 조건문에서 조건과 결과가 논리적으로 일치하는 문장은 2번이다.

options: I never took off my life jacket *while* I was on the ship.
*While* walking around, I found a purse on the floor.
*After* I fell asleep, I had the medicine.
Anne visited my house *after* she called me.
*After* he ate dinner, he watched TV.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 흐름상 어색한 것은?

options: He said his last words *after* he died.
*While* you brush your teeth, go to bed.
*While* I was shopping, I met Judy.
*After* I was walking home, I saw him.
Call me *while* you arrive.
questions.question: 다음 while과 after의 쓰임이 적절하게 이루어진 문장을 고르면?
questions.explanation: '양치질하면서 잠을 자다'는 문법적으로 맞지 않다.

options: Jane is very kind, *while* her sister is mean.
*While* she was studying, she listened to music.
I believe ghosts exist, *while* she doesn't believe it.
She broke her arm *while* she was snowboarding.
*While* vegetables are good for your health, you should eat them.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 흐름상 어색한 것은?

options: Prepare the sauce *while* the pasta is cooking.
They arrived *while* we were having lunch.
*While* I was waiting for the bus, I saw a handsome boy.
*While* you are in Suwon, taste Suwon galbi.
*While* Amy likes outdoor sports very much, her sister doesn't like them.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈 곳에 while의 의미가 나머지와 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 1-4번의 while은 '~하면서' 또는 '~하는 동안'이라는 시간적 의미이지만, 5번의 while은 '반면에'라는 대조의 의미를 가진다.

options: *While* I like math, my sister likes English.
*While* I'm good at sports, she's good at art.
*While* you don't like ice cream, I like it a lot.
*While* you are having lunch, you can watch TV.
*While* there are some good sides to wearing school uniforms, there are also bad sides to it.
questions.question: 다음 중 While의 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 1-3, 5번의 while은 대조의 의미이지만, 4번은 시간적 의미의 '동안'을 나타낸다.

options: He did not go since he was ill.
I must stop now since I have to go out.
I'll buy you popcorn since you paid for coke.
We have been friends since we were 13 years old.
Since I've just started learning Chinese, I can't speak Chinese well.
questions.question:
다음 중 Since의 의미가 <보기>와 다른 것은?

<보기> I enjoy reading books *since* helps me to be creative.
questions.explanation: 1-3, 5번의 since는 이유, 원인의 의미인 'because'의 의미이지만, 4번은 시간적 의미인 '~이래로'를 나타낸다.

options: The ice cream is melting *as* the weather is hot.
The baby is crying *because* she is hungry.
*As* she got up too early, she is sleepy now.
He wears glasses every day *since* he has bad sight.
*Since* he was at age 6, he has been in Seoul.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 1-4번은 이유, 원인의 의미이지만, 5번의 since는 '~이래로'라는 시간적 의미를 나타낸다.

options: Since it was Friday, I stayed up late.
I haven't heard from him since last year.
Since I had a bad cold, I stayed at home all day long.
Since I'm very tired, I'm going to go to bed right away.
We don't have to go to school since tomorrow is a holiday.
questions.question: 다음 중 Since의 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 1, 3-5번의 since는 이유, 원인의 의미이지만, 2번의 since는 '~이래로'라는 시간적 의미를 나타낸다.

options: Take your umbrella since it's raining outside.
Mike didn't come to school since he had a cold.
You should cook dinner since you're a good cook.
He has been sick since he graduated from university.
I couldn't buy the book since I used up my allowance.
questions.question: 다음 중 Since의 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 1-3, 5번의 since는 이유, 원인의 의미이지만, 4번의 since는 '~이래로'라는 시간적 의미를 나타낸다.

options: Minho was absent today *since* he was sick.
Sujin will help me *since* she is my best frined.
I have studied English *since* I was ten years old.
He likes this town *since* people are very polite and kind.
She has lived in Seoul *since* she was nineteen.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 같은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

options: He is not very active although he's nearly 80.
Though I took a wrong bus, I was late for the meeting.
Even though the sun was shining, it was very warm.
Despite my illness, I was absent from school.
I like my brother though he sometimes makes me angry.
questions.question: 다음 중 흐름상 가장 자연스러운 문장은?

options: She couldn't get good grades although she studied very hard.
Although he studied hard, he got a good grade on the test.
She could see with her heart although she was blind.
Although Kevin's aunt lives in China, she doesn't speak Chinese.
Although coke is not good for our health, the doctor advised me to drink it every day.
questions.question: 다음 중 흐름상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 의약적으로 코크가 건강에 해롭지 않다면 의사가 매일 마시라고 권고할 리 없으므로 어색하다.

options: We went on a picnic though it was rainy.
She failed the test even though she had studied hard.
He is strong and healthy though he is seventy years old.
She couldn't eat the meal though she was very hungry.
He didn't go to school even though he was sick.
questions.question: 다음 중 흐름상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 아팠으면 학교에 가지 않는 것이 자연스러우므로 역접이 맞지 않는다.

options: Although Sarah was sick, she wasn't absent from school.
Though Tom studied hard, he got poor grades.
Cathy was very hungry although she didn't have breakfast.
Even though I caught a cold, I couldn't go to school.
Though it was cold, we took a walk in the park.
questions.question: 다음 중 흐름상 어색한 문장은? (정답 2개)

options: I will go to the park with my family if it is sunny.
If she won't get up now, she miss the bus.
He will get good grades if he will study harder.
If he come back home, I'll cook special food.
If I run, I am on time for the meeting.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?

options: If you sleep well, you felt better.
They saw you if they will see me.
We go outside if it was sunny later.
If I will see her, I'll tell her to call you.
I'll tell you the great news if I see you.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?

options: Despite it rained heavily, we played soccer.
Though it rained heavily, we played soccer.
In spite of the heavy rain, we played soccer.
Although it rained heavily, we played soccer.
Even though it rained heavily, we played soccer.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: Despite 다음에는 명사나 동명사가 와야 하므로 'Despite it rained heavily'는 틀렸다. 'Despite the heavy rain' 또는 'Despite the fact that it rained heavily'가 올바르다.

options: Unless he is so wise, he is able to solve problems.
If you don't start now, you will be late.
If it will rain tomorrow, the event won't be held.
Unless it work properly, you should fix it.
Unless you will exercise, you are not healthy.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?

options: Despite he lost his job, his uncle wastes his money.
Despite the pearl looks real, it is fake.
Although rained a lot, Jessica went camping.
Although the heavy rain, they played outside.
He is quite strong although he is very old.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?

options: I'll see you after the class will be over.
My favorite show will be on after this.
Before you go to bed, turn off the light.
After dinner, you can eat your ice cream.
Check your homework before you go home.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: after 뒤에는 현재형이나 완료형을 써야 하므로 'after the class will be over'는 틀렸다. 'after the class is over' 또는 'after the class finishes'가 올바르다.

options: Since John is our friend, he'll help us.
He went to bed early since he was sick.
Since it's raining outside, I'll stay at home.
She got up late since she missed the school bus.
Since tomorrow is Sunday, I don't have to get up early.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?

options: Despite he was old, he still led an active life.
We didn't stay outside long because of it was too cold.
Since my sister lied to me, I was angry at her.
He was absent today because his illness.
Although the danger signs, we swam there.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?

options: While Tom read a book, I ate all the cookies.
After she ate dinner, she wrote a letter.
After Alice drank water, she became smaller.
I ride an indoor bike at home while watching TV.
After you will finish the work, I will ask you a question.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: After 뒤에는 현재형이나 완료형을 써야 하므로 'After you will finish'는 틀렸다. 'After you finish'가 올바르다.

options: After watched TV, studied English.
After we play soccer, and we'll go home.
After seeing the doctor, she went to school.
After pick a lot of shellfish, they go back home.
After went to the movies, she bought some clothes.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올은 문장을 고르면?

options: Despite of the storm, the airplane landed safely.
I felt sick in spite of the fact that I took medicine.
I couldn't get up despite the alarm rang many times.
My dad didn't eat anything even though the hunger.
Even if the fact that I woke up early, I was late for work.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?

options: In spite of he has no money, he is still happy.
Although his diligence, he failed the test.
Although she studied hard, she gets straight Ds.
Even though worked hard, Tom couldn't finish his report.
She couldn't understand the instructions even though she read them twice.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?

options: 0개
1개
2개
3개
4개
questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?

⊙ Although the danger signs, we swam there.
⊙ Despite he was old, he still led an active life.
⊙ I drink coffee although it makes me nervous.
⊙ Although it was very muddy, the game went on.
⊙ We enjoyed the day at the park though the bad weather.
⊙ Despite she was a great writer, she wasn't famous at that time.
questions.explanation: 올바른 문장: 'Although the danger signs, we swam there.' / 'Despite he was old, he still led an active life.' / 'I drink coffee although it makes me nervous.' / 'Although it was very muddy, the game went on.' / 'We enjoyed the day at the park though the bad weather.' / 'Despite she was a great writer, she wasn't famous at that time.'
